title: Median-support empirical-noise capability qualification
honesty_note: Y WAS ALREADY READ BY THE MACHINE in the timing/equivalence probe, so this is NOT 'before Y access'. The adaptation was driven by measured RUNTIME only — no capability result, no theta value, no historical ranking was inspected. Those are separate facts and both are recorded.
design_error_recorded: The original spec was frozen without a feasibility measurement. Combo Miner did this correctly (Gate C priced the band before the design was fixed); that step was skipped here and the cost only surfaced after freezing.
base_noise: the real mfe_10d vector, permuted within the registered blocks — real scale, tails, date shocks and heteroskedasticity kept; sequence-outcome association destroyed
injection: delta added ONLY to the frozen needle's membership, inside its overlap blocks
detection: theta_needle > p95 of that world's max-null across all 840 claims
band: recomputed separately for every (world, delta); never shared across deltas

pairing.outer: ONE outer base world per (needle, world_index): default_rng([20260820, needle_index, world_index]). The SAME base world is used for all six deltas of that needle/world.
pairing.inner: ONE set of 999 inner permutation mappings per (needle, world_index): default_rng([20260821, needle_index, world_index, perm_index]). The SAME mappings are applied at every delta.
pairing.band: theta_perm[999 x 840] and max_null[999] are RECOMPUTED separately for every delta, because the injected Y differs by delta and the permuted maxima may too. SHARED RANDOMNESS, SEPARATE BANDS — never one band reused across deltas.

rng.separation: outer and inner streams are independent so that the randomness making a world is not tied to the randomness building that world's band

deferred.rule: if completed BEFORE historical EXPOSE they extend the pre-exposure qualification; if run after, they are POST-EXPOSURE SENSITIVITY CHARACTERIZATION and cannot strengthen it

verdict_scope: At approximately median claim support (treated n=682), the registered search has the measured empirical-noise detection profile below. Sensitivity at low and high support was NOT qualified pre-exposure.
forbidden_claim: T5 sequence miner is well powered
may_not: become a promotion route for any claim
interpretation_contract: Validity = whole 840-claim design · Sensitivity = qualified only around q50 support · Historical result = whole 840-claim search
gate_before_historical_compute: the detection surface must be read before the sealed historical compute is launched; a poor surface does not change k, grammar, support, null or estimand — it fixes the language the historical result may be read in
